name: quota-watch
description: The CEO's 93% quota rule: polls every 5 minutes for the whole session and wakes the lead at the threshold, the hold's release, the reset and a reading that stays unknown

name: stall-watch
description: Wakes the lead the moment teammate work stalls or a teammate escalates: a resource wait over 10 minutes, a live teammate with no commit and no transcript activity for 20 minutes, a teammate waiting on a slot its own process holds, or a new teammate escalation (again every 10 minutes while one needs the CEO at a device). Looks every 60 s and tells each once. Tells an idle lead its due work (finished work with no wait, held work with no checkable end or whose end came true) once, and again every 30 minutes while it stays due. Also ends only owned idle commands deferring an already ended teammate turn

name: codex-watch
description: Wakes the lead when Codex writes to it: each new entry in ~/.richos-coordination/rich-codex/to-rich.md or rich-codex-questions/to-rich.md is told once, with every one of its lines. Looks every 15 s and only reads

name: review-watch
description: Starts the second review by itself (the CEO's ruling 113): a different model reviews a teammate's own commits at its handover, every hour of a long job, when it goes quiet, and at each Codex READY entry, in the repositories SECOND_REVIEW_REPOS lists. Looks every 60 s, tells each verdict once, and again every 30 minutes while a changes-requested handover has no continuation
